source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Cleaning the shared equipment only once per day, regardless of how many clients have used it in between","B":"Reusing the same mouthpiece across multiple clients without performing any cleaning in between uses","C":"Fairly few specific infection control measures actually being needed for this kind of pulmonary function testing","D":"Using disposable, single-use mouthpieces/filters or thoroughly disinfecting reusable components between each client"}}
source_row.rationale: Spirometry infection control between clients includes using disposable, single-use mouthpieces/filters, or thoroughly disinfecting reusable components between each client, given the direct respiratory contact involved in this testing and the potential for pathogen transmission via shared equipment.
source_row.source_name: AARC — Pulmonary Function Testing Infection Control
